items.clean_view: Unaccepted model or LLM semantic output may not become governing authority merely because it was generated.
items.shown_view: The model or provider that generated a semantic interpretation may decide that its output becomes governing authority when its confidence is sufficiently high.
items.detection_criterion: Identify that model or provider confidence cannot confer governing authority; admission through the proper governing path is required.

items.clean_view: Research 436 successor development does not itself authorize physical migration or operational authority switch; either requires separate governing authorization.

items.detection_criterion: Identify the improper narrowing that permits physical migration; Research 436 authorizes neither migration nor authority switch by itself.
